title: The Latest Crier for Feb 28, 2026
items:
ZY Sweets For Your Sweetie Fundraiser

Buy some Sweets for your Sweetie from Zeta Upsilon Feb 9-12, from 5-8 pm in the Maytag Atrium for only $3! You can choose between chocolate candies, fruit-flavored candies, or a mix to show how well you know your Sweetie!

Late Night Central Art Event: Altered Books | Friday, Feb. 27 | 8-10pm | Maytag

Friday, February 27 | 8-10pm | Maytag Student Center 
All students are welcome to join us for this one-of-a-kind special Late Night Central event. Mary Robertson will guide us through an art project called Altered Books. This is a visual storytelling medium that allows you to explore and engage with the diverse world of arts and culture. Taking inspiration from underrepresented artists and influenced by graffiti and textured collages, we will have fun, create art, and tell stories by exploring the process of Altered Books.

The Leprechaun’s Heist: Escape the Room

A leprechaun has swiped your gold—do you have what it takes to get it back? Gather a team of up to four for a high-stakes, 30-minute race against the clock. Solve riddles, crack codes, and outwit the luck of the Irish! 

Date: Sunday, March 1 

Time: 7:00 PM – 9:00 PM (Arrive 10 minutes early) 

Location: BMW Rooms 

The fastest team wins a grand prize and campus-wide bragging rights. Spots are limited—sign up now! (must use central email in order to sign up) 

Click to Sign Up

Planning to stay in Pella this summer? Need a place to live?

Click here to find out more information about on-campus housing and fill out the summer student facility use contract. Space is limited so fill out the form and pay your first two weeks' rent by Wednesday, April 1st to reserve your spot. Contact Sarah Lunsford (lunsfords@central.edu) if you have any questions.

Gardeners needed!

The Central College Garden is seeking new gardeners for 2026! We are a small group of volunteers who grow fruits and vegetables and maintain the space at the Central College Garden on the corner of Peace and W. 3rd. We welcome anyone who wants space to grow their own crops and/or would like to collaborate and help out with garden maintenance. We are especially seeking a volunteer to help us manage the native flowering plants in the Monarch Waystation. If you don't have much gardening experience but want to learn, we'll pair you with an established gardener. If interested, please contact Mary Robertson or Valerie Billing.

Final Days to Apply for Paid Student Leader Positions for Summer & Fall 2026

Lead. Serve. Get Paid. Apply now for paid student leader positions for Fall 2026 : CAB | RA | SOS Make an impact on campus and grow your leadership skills. Apply by March 1! Link to Apply: https://app.joinhandshake.com/e/1010657/jobs

Green Careers Job Panel

Are you interested in a green career? Want to know more about working in a green career? 
Come to SCATE's Green Careers Panel Monday March 2nd at 8pm in VSC 180. 

We will have professionals from different careers (including Central College Alumni) to talk about what they do and how they got into their role. 

If you have any questions or want to know more reach out to Summer at Chamberss1@central.edu.

STUDENT TRUSTEE SPOTS OPEN!

Student Trustee Applications are OPEN NOW and due March 6th at 5pm 
What is a Student Trustee? 

- A non-voting representative to the Board of Trustees and the voice for students during important decision-making processes 

How do I apply? 

- The application can be found in your Central email from ssenate@central.eduIt or at MyCentral > Student Life > Student Senate 

Who are the current Student Trustees? 

- Parker Lawrence, Madison Craig, Elyse Shaw, Cassie Elliott, and Mya Ehresman

Central College Mission Statement

Central College is a welcoming learning community committed to vigorous and open inquiry as the best preparation for lives of integrity, creativity, and adaptability. Our students learn collaboratively with supportive educators who share a commitment to intellectual engagement, personal growth, career readiness and civic involvement.Shaped by its Christian heritage, Central College values inclusivity, humility, kindness, and hospitality, and invites learners of all backgrounds and faiths to join us in the pursuit of knowledge, opportunity, and fulfillment.

Pre-Health Students!

Grad Schools are coming in March!! 
Check your email for a Handshake invite to the Pre-Health info sessions on March 24 & 26. You will want to attend no matter when you graduate. Hear what the schools have to say during a Q&A time at 11:30 - then from 12-1 pm visit with the schools at their tables. 

Visit with Cyndi Boertje (Geisler - Room 261) if you are pre-health and you did not get an invite.

First Date

Join us in the Kruidenier Center February 26th-28th at 7pm and March 1st at 2pm for the Visual & Performing Arts production of First Date. 
When blind date newbie Aaron is set up with serial-dater Casey, a casual drink at a busy New York restraunt turns into a hilarious high-stakes dinner. Can this couple turn what could be a dating disaster into something special before the check arrives? 

For tickets go to https://central.universitytickets.com

Language Placement Test

Students who need to take a Language Placement Test for Spanish or German can stop by the Vermeer Science Center (VSC), Room #241 from 11:00am-12:00pm on Tuesday, March 10th. Use the following link to add your name and select a time to confirm your attendance. Contact Dr. Ally Krogstad ( krogstada@central.edu ) or Prof. Oscar Reynaga ( reynagao@central.edu ) if you have any questions.

St. Mary's Catholic Church FREE shuttle bus to Sunday Mass

The Free shuttle bus to St. Mary's Catholic Church for Mass will run this Sunday 3/1/26. Pick-up will be on the west side of Central Market from 10:10 am to 10:15 am and at Independence and 3rd (4-way stop) from 10:16 am to 10:18 am. 
Pick-up times are carefully followed. Return drop-off will be at Central Market. No reservations are required. 

If you would like a weekly email with confirmation that the shuttle bus services will be provided that Sunday please email fullerj@central.edu

Summer Internship?

Let us know!! If your internship is non-credit for the summer, please give us the deets so we can help future students as they search for internships. It's a quick few questions in Handshake. 
If you want credits for your internship , meet with Cyndi Boertje to get all the information you need to get it in Handshake. 

Thank you!!

DEATHTRAP Auditions

Want to be in a fun thriller/comedy? The Department of Visual and Performing Arts will hold auditions for DEATHTRAP on Monday, March 2 at 6:30pm in the Kruidenier Theatre. The auditions will be cold readings from the script. The show runs April 22-25th, 2026. Roles are available for 3 men and 2 women. If you'd like to read the script ahead of time, please email Dr. Adamson at adamsonc@central.edu.
